notes.title: Daydam Knight 1.2.10
notes.content:
[b]Daydam Knight 1.2.10[/b]
- Modified card descriptions
- Adjusted slider fill rate in the tutorial
- Fixed bug where cards were removed
- Implemented shield limit
- Changed order of special cards
- Modified functionality of the Hellfire card
- Added button to return to the menu from the reward stage
- Adjusted levels and corrected particle systems
- Modified shield card
- Limited the number of columns
- Fixed bug where energy would reset to zero
- Changed enchantment functionality
- Fixed bug with reward collection
